image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) lying on dark, wet sand mixed with small shell fragments. The crab is oriented vertically with its head at the top. The carapace is broad and oval, showing a mottled pattern of brownish-tan and cream colors. The ventral side (abdomen) is partially visible between the legs. Two large claws (chelipeds) are prominent at the front, with dark tips. Several walking legs extend laterally from the body. The texture appears hard and calcified, consistent with a crustacean exoskeleton.
